### 📋 Pull Request Guidelines

## 🧑‍💻 Contributor Checklist

Before requesting a review, make sure you've completed all of the following:

- [ ] New developement has been tested in a small test setting
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated in the code and RTD
- [ ] Extend the checklist for reviewers: Which aspects should be reviewed in particular?

```markdown
<!-- Example:
Please focus on updates in file XYZ.
-->
```

If needed:

- [ ] Changes have been tested in a bigger calculation



---

## 🔍 Reviewer Checklist

During your review, please check the following:

- [ ] Is the code clean, readable, documented and efficient? Are there any oddities or obvious inefficiencies?
- [ ] Does the code work as expected? _(should already be verified by contributor)_
- [ ] Do all github tests pass? (see CI results)
- [ ] Individual checks the contributer requested are performed
